points.description: Names the two phases: slow start and congestion avoidance.
Slow start: cwnd grows exponentially (increased by 1 per ACK, i.e. doubling each RTT) while cwnd < ss_thresh; ss_thresh is not changed during normal growth.
points.partial_credit: Says cwnd grows fast/increases but not exponential or per-ACK/RTT detail.

points.description: Congestion avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh): cwnd grows slowly/linearly (e.g. +1 per RTT / after all segments are acknowledged).
points.partial_credit: Says cwnd grows slower but gives no linear rule.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both phases named plus how cwnd changes in each (exponential in slow start, linear in congestion avoidance). Give part marks for vague growth descriptions without exponential/linear or for naming only one phase. Mentioning that on loss ss_thresh = cwnd/2 and cwnd resets to 1 is correct extra detail but not required; a wrong statement loses only that point.
